properties.name: Cat #110
properties.description: Friendly cat always outside Mordecai Richler Library, nice place to take a pause, read a book, meet this friend

properties.name: Holly
properties.description: Holly is a loyal friend. If she doesn't know you, she may be hesitant to be near you. But if you show her love and care, she will love you forever. Holly is tired here, and quite sick. She is still so kind and loving though.
